name: Análisis de Gama de Color
description: Detecta out-of-gamut or unnaturally distributed colors. AI images often produce colors that exceed the natural camera gamut with excessive vibrancy.
algorithm: Color Gamut Range and Saturation Distribution Analysis
mechanism: Mide extreme, near-clipping, and high-saturación-high-brillo pixel ratios para identificar generado por IA color patrones.
parameters: Sampling: 50000 pixels, Metrics: extreme ratio, clip ratio, vibrant ratio
useCase: Identifying unnaturally vibrant colors in generado por IA content

references.title: Finlayson, G.D. et al. (2005). On the Removal of Shadows from Images. IEEE TPAMI.
Larson, G.W. et al. (1998). A Visibility Matching Tone Reproduction. IEEE CG&A.
Sharma, G. (2003). Digital Color Imaging Handbook. CRC Press.

strengths:
• Identifica physically impossible color combinations
• Camera-independent análisis approach
• Reveals AI-specific espacio de color usage patrones
• Fast análisis of color distribución
• Strong indicator when out-of-gamut colors detected
limitations:
• Camera color profiles vary widely entre manufacturers
• Post-processing and color grading change gamut coverage
• Wide-gamut displays and HDR expand valid espacio de color
• ICC profile-aware editors produce legitimate wide-gamut
• Some AI models now generate dentro de natural gamut
